newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm, but in shadows of gasoline.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm, but in shadows of gasoline.

text.p: NWE naphtha remained in the shadows of surging gasoline with dealers commenting that supplies are not as tight as has been suggested.

A 2,000 tonne parcel of N+A was sold at $195 fob ARA and the buyer commented that 10,000 tonnes of Russian material would be on offer next week and at least 5,000 tonnes of barges were also up for grabs.
The continued gasoline rally gives strong underpinning to naphtha and the outlook appears firm.
"If the gasoline rally can not be sustained then naphtha will not be able to go trans-atlantic and the Far East is not looking too strong either," said one dealer.
But if gasoline's strength is maintained sellers may see buyers scrabbling for material pushing cif NWE prices into the high $190s.
